≻.justification: Forward morphism driving two distinct IMASM words toward the fusion interface; the low-barrier kinetics (𐑘) allow free exploration of the fused configuration.

≺.justification: Contravariant morphism executing the fission half of the hotswap; the Z2-protected transition (𐑴) guarantees the reverse path is topologically distinct from the forward path.

⋈.justification: Sequential composition that chains the lossless state transfer across the scale-collapse boundary; high-fidelity geometry (𐑐) ensures near-certain firing.

∈.justification: The fusion mechanism (∋=𐑝) requires exactly two specific words simultaneously; FSPLIT opens the T-arm for word A and F-arm for word B as the required conjunctive pair.

∋.justification: Reunites the two arms after the hotswap cycle completes; conflicting arms rejoin to B (both states held) because the critical-phase exchange (⊙=⊙) preserves both identities in superposition.

⊤.justification: Deposits constructive truth (T) on the T-arm: word A's state is affirmatively transferred across the fusion interface.

⊥.justification: Deposits constructive falsity (F) on the F-arm: word B's state is affirmatively transferred as the complementary partner; the Frobenius polarity (≺=𐑹) makes this the exact inverse operation.

⊞.justification: At the critical threshold (⊙=⊙), both word states are held simultaneously (B-state) without resolution; the correlation length diverges (ξ→∞) and μ∘δ=id holds exactly.

⊡.justification: Permanent append-only record of each completed fusion-fission cycle; the low barrier (𐑘) allows many cycles but each fixation is irreversible.
